name: Pending Reason 32 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why a cancellation request sent for the related instruction is pending.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Instruction was received after the account servicer's deadline. It will be managed as per the bilateral service agreement between the account servicer and account owner.

CDCY.name: Conditional Currency
CDCY.definition: Execution is conditional to the execution of a process linked to the currency of the transaction.

CDRE.name: Conditional Realignement
CDRE.definition: Execution is conditional to the execution of a process of realignment at the issuer CSD.

CDRG.name: Conditional Registrar
CDRG.definition: Execution is conditional to the execution of a process at the registrar.
